text: Statement: "To build a house, one must have a plan." Which assumption does this statement make?
optionA: Having a plan guarantees that the house will be built well.

optionC: Only engineers are allowed to build houses.
optionD: Houses built with a plan cost less.

optionC: Most businesses fail within their first year.

Is this argument valid? "All scientists do research. Some people are scientists. Therefore, some people do research."
optionA: Valid: the conclusion must follow from the premises.
optionB: Invalid: the scientists might not be among the people.
optionC: Invalid: the conclusion should say all people do research.
optionD: Valid only if every person is a scientist.

text: Is this argument valid? "All birds sing. Sparky sings. Therefore, Sparky is a bird."
optionA: Valid: Sparky sings, so Sparky must be a bird.
optionB: Invalid: things other than birds may also sing.
optionD: Invalid: the premises contradict each other.
